en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Al Qasim Bin Suleyman, from Sama’at Bin Mihran, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [57:28] He will give you all two portions of His Mercy
and Make for you a Light with which you will walk.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The ‘نُور’ (Light) stands for an Imam<sup>asws</sup> you follow’.
en.sarwar: 86. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Sama‘ from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious. “. . Fulfill your covenant with Me ..” (the covenant to acknowledge Wilaya of Ali (a.s.)) and I shall fulfill Mine (admit you in paradise).. .” [2:40]
